sections.title: THE GAME
sections.content: **Aeon Must Die!** is a sci-fi beat 'em up combining fast-paced tactical combat, risk-reward mechanics, and a distinctive anime-inspired art style. Set in a futuristic universe, the game tells a story of betrayal, revenge, and the struggle for free will.
